name: Laws of the Game
source: Law 12 of the IFAB Laws of the Game, with the usual report abbreviations; checked against halfline.app/codes on 2026-10-26.

cautions.description: Failure to respect the required distance
Entering or re-entering the field of play without permission
Deliberately leaving the field of play without permission

sendOffs.description: Denying a goal or an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by a deliberate handball
Denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity by an offense punishable by a free kick
Offensive, insulting or abusive language or gestures
Second caution in the same match
